purpose: Prospectively validate the real operational JNU decision process as used in user-facing forecasts. This validates the discretionary evidence-fusion process, not a mechanical directional-alpha module.

inclusion_rule.formal_forecast: Every future user-facing JNU/Osaka Micro Nikkei analysis that gives a directional bias and has an exact JNU/Micro reference price with timestamp must be registered before its target endpoint.
inclusion_rule.abstention: NEUTRAL/ABSTAIN forecasts are also registered and count toward coverage but not directional hit-rate.
inclusion_rule.correction_rule: A correction may supersede a record only before the target endpoint and must preserve the original record plus a reason.

primary_horizon.target: Next OSE Nikkei 225 Micro Futures regular day-session close after the forecast timestamp.
primary_horizon.start: Exact JNU/Micro reference price observed at the forecast timestamp from a timestamped user screenshot or trusted exact-product live source.
primary_horizon.note: A forecast without an exact timestamped JNU/Micro reference price is operationally useful but ineligible for primary shadow scoring.

confidence_rule: HIGH is not used in the formal shadow ledger while validated directional modules remain zero. Confidence labels are ordinal, not calibrated probabilities.
probability_rule: Do not present numeric values as calibrated model probabilities. Judgmental scenario weights may be discussed only when explicitly labelled non-calibrated and are not used for primary shadow scoring.

metrics: maximum adverse excursion where exact intraday outcome data are available
first_review_gate: 5-forecast moving-block bootstrap P(mean signed outcome return > 0) >= 0.90
scoring.interpretation: A pass supports the operational evidence-fusion process prospectively. It does not create a mechanical validated directional-alpha module.

prohibited: Omit losing forecasts from the ledger
Backfill forecasts after the target close
Use proxy SGX/CME price as exact JNU starting price for scored records
Promote a shadow-process pass to mechanical alpha
